You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

translations.web: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
translations.bsb: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
translations.kjv: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
translations.asv: Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah
